title: Universal Dataset Collector
summary: A chat-based data collection system that discovers, scrapes, merges, and augments ML datasets via a local LLM pipeline. Its synthetic.py module uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer (with SingleTableMetadata) to generate synthetic rows when augmenting a collected dataset.
